item.title: Episode 2: Origin Stories
item.description: Part of the series: Lead Us Not It was a powerful story that inspired a movement: Jean Vanier heard a call—from Jesus and people suffering in mental institutions—and decided to invite some men with intellectual disabilities to live with him. The only problem? It wasn’t true. When Vanier was alive, his saintly reputation stole the spotlight. Now, it’s Vanier’s dark shadow that eclipses the other stories of L’Arche.
